  <header class="hero">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span class="eyebrow"><span class="pin"></span>Masirah Island · Oman · IKO Centre</span>
      <h1 class="display">Kitesurf<br><span class="l2">Masirah</span></h1>
      <p class="lead">Oman's best-kept kitesurfing secret — steady monsoon wind, a huge flat lagoon, empty beaches, and warm turquoise water. Learn or ride with GET, the island's main kite operator.</p>
      <div class="hero-cta">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/96877333579?text=Hi%20Kitesurf%20Oman%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20book%20a%20Masirah%20session">Book a session</a>
        <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#centre">The IKO Centre</a>
      </div>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat"><div class="k">May–Sep</div><div class="v">Main wind season (Khareef)</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="k">20–40kt</div><div class="v">Steady southerly wind</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="k">24–38°C</div><div class="v">Cool while the mainland bakes</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="k">Flat + wave</div><div class="v">Lagoon west, ocean east</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <section>
    <div class="section-w">
      <div class="tag">The spot</div>
      <h2 class="h2">One island, every kind of ride</h2>
      <p class="intro">Masirah sits in the path of the Indian Ocean monsoon off Oman's east coast. The island's shape gives you two very different playgrounds within minutes of each other.</p>
      <div class="spot-grid">
        <div class="spot">
          <div class="ic"><svg></svg></div>
          <div class="n">Flat-water lagoon (west)</div>
          <p>A vast, shallow lagoon sheltered from the swell — smooth water even in strong wind. Ideal for first lessons, freestyle and speed runs.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="spot">
          <div class="ic"><svg></svg></div>
          <div class="n">Ocean waves (east)</div>
          <p>The Arabian Sea side serves everything from mellow shore break to proper swell for riders chasing waves.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="spot">
          <div class="ic"><svg></svg></div>
          <div class="n">Reliable monsoon wind</div>
          <p>From roughly mid-June to August the wind blows almost every day. May and September are lighter — perfect for learning.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="spot">
          <div class="ic"><svg></svg></div>
          <div class="n">Uncrowded & unspoilt</div>
          <p>No packed line-ups or busy launches. Wide empty beaches, traditional Omani culture, and long uninterrupted sessions.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section class="band" id="centre">
    <div class="section-w op">
      <div>
        <span class="badge">● IKO-certified centre</span>
        <h2 class="h2">The Masirah kite centre, run by GET</h2>
        <p class="intro">GET is the island's main kite operator. Our IKO-affiliated centre means internationally recognised teaching standards, certified instructors, and a safe, structured way to progress — whether it's your first day on a kite or your hundredth.</p>
        <div class="hero-cta" style="margin-top:28px">
          <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/96877333579?text=Hi%20Kitesurf%20Oman%2C%20I%27d%20like%20to%20book%20a%20Masirah%20session">Book with GET</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <ul class="list">
        <li><span class="chk">✓</span><div><strong>IKO-certified instruction</strong> — standardised levels and a recognised card you can use at any IKO centre worldwide.</div></li>
        <li><span class="chk">✓</span><div><strong>Beginner to advanced lessons</strong> — from your first flat-water session to waves and freestyle coaching.</div></li>
        <li><span class="chk">✓</span><div><strong>Gear rental</strong> — modern kites and boards on site, so you can travel light.</div></li>
        <li><span class="chk">✓</span><div><strong>Safety cover</strong> — rescue support on the water and experienced staff on hand.</div></li>
        <li><span class="chk">✓</span><div><strong>Full packages</strong> — GET can arrange accommodation, transfers and the whole Masirah trip.</div></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section>
    <div class="section-w">
      <div class="tag">When to come</div>
      <h2 class="h2">Best months to ride</h2>
      <p class="intro">Masirah has wind most of the year, but the summer monsoon is what riders travel for.</p>
      <div class="months">
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Jan</span>light</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Feb</span>light</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Mar</span>light</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Apr</span>early</div>
        <div class="m mid"><span class="mm">May</span>good</div>
        <div class="m hi"><span class="mm">Jun</span>peak</div>
        <div class="m hi"><span class="mm">Jul</span>peak</div>
        <div class="m hi"><span class="mm">Aug</span>peak</div>
        <div class="m mid"><span class="mm">Sep</span>good</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Oct</span>varied</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Nov</span>varied</div>
        <div class="m"><span class="mm">Dec</span>varied</div>
      </div>
      <div class="legend">
        <span><span class="dot" style="background:var(--water)"></span>Peak monsoon — strong daily wind</span>
        <span><span class="dot" style="background:var(--water-soft)"></span>Great for learning — lighter, steady</span>
        <span><span class="dot" style="background:#e6ecec;border:1px solid var(--line)"></span>Off-season — variable</span>
      </div>
